composition_subtypes.role: Slide left and right pointers to maintain valid window; j and i only move forward, O(n)
Maintain sorted list via bisect insert/delete to get O(1) min/max and check k-condition

payload.composition_order: first amortized_two_pointers to expand/shrink window, then ds_ordered_set to manage elements
payload.core_composition_summary: Combines sliding window two-pointers with a sorted list acting as an ordered set for efficient min/max queries and dynamic updates.
payload.rationale: The solution uses two pointers to track window bounds and a sorted list (bisect-based insert/remove) to maintain window elements in order, enabling fast condition checks. Both are essential and interleaved.
